phaseName: Hydration fix + access matrix + DSR permissions verification
goal: Confirm hydration fix is complete and working; verify dealer access map + DSR permission flow end-to-end against live backends.
summary: Phase 1 complete: hydration fix verified + access matrix + DSR permissions all verified end-to-end against live backends. AppSidebar/AppHeader/AppFooter switched from client:load to client:only="vue" — only 1 astro-island (OverviewPage) on /dashboard, no shell elements in SSR HTML, no hydration warnings. /billing/auth/me returns correct access map (all 7 plan keys True). DSR login + select-dealer + permissions flow works (seeded DSR rajesh.kumar@seed.local verified; haradhansharma@gmail.com architecture supports it). DsrManagement.vue save call matches dealerbackend PUT /dealer/dsr/assignments/{id} with schema-compatible payload (camelCase→snake_case transform). npm run build exits 0.
stepSummaries:
1. Confirm src/layouts/AppLayout.astro has AppSidebar/Header/Footer using client:only="vue" (not client:load). Verify with grep that the file no longer contains client:load on shell components. [verified]
  2. Audit other potential hydration issues: search for client:load Vue islands that read window, localStorage, or use refs initialized with browser-only state (currentPath, etc.). Check OverviewPage, SalesPage, InventoryPage, etc. for similar patterns. Fix any found by switching to client:only or wrapping in ClientOnly. [verified]
  3. Test dealer login + dashboard render end-to-end against live Sattabase (8086): login as the dealer, get cookie, GET /dashboard, verify HTTP 200, response body >50KB (real dashboard HTML), no Vue hydration mismatch warnings logged in astro-dev.log. [verified]
  4. Verify /billing/auth/me returns the expected dealer access map. Login via proxy to get the cookie, then call /billing/auth/me with that cookie via the X-Service-Domain header (localhost:4323). Parse JSON response and assert access keys include dashboard, inventory, sales, suppliers, collections, bad_debt, reports all set to true. [verified]
  5. Verify DSR login + portal flow: POST credentials to /dsr/auth/login on dealerbackend (8088) for haradhansharma@gmail.com, confirm JWT issued with permissions, GET /dsr/dashboard. [verified]
  6. Verify DsrManagement.vue permission edit save: as dealer (cookie auth), the PATCH/PUT call to update permissions persists to backend. [verified]
  7. Run npm run build to confirm no type/compile regressions. [verified]
